truth_policy.metric_definition: Record-level metrics use synsigra_hrv_metrics_v2 and the synsigra_nn_exclusion_v2 preprocessing policy. A submission must declare the same measurement identity.
truth_policy.metric_acceptance: Each of the 15 summary metrics must be supplied exactly once with matching status and must satisfy the packaged per-metric absolute-or-relative tolerance.
truth_policy.rr_association: Valid beat-level RR intervals are associated by R-peak-anchored interval overlap. FP splits and FN merges remain local; unique truth and submission coverage cannot exceed 100%.
truth_policy.case_independence: Every generated signal is an independent acceptance stratum. No pooled case or cross-case average can compensate for a failure.
truth_policy.threshold_boundary: The single official policy is pre-specified for this deterministic engineering protocol. It is not a clinical HRV normal-range or standards-conformity claim.

evidence_boundary: Synthetic engineering QA evidence for RR and HRV implementation; not diagnosis, clinical autonomic validation, patient-population evidence, or regulatory qualification.
